description: AISTATS 2027's style file aistats2027.sty ('2026/09/02 AISTATS2027 submission/camera-ready style file'), on article with twoside as its template sets it. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from AISTATS2027PaperPack.zip on aistats.org, linked from the 2027 call for papers. Its fancyhdr.sty copy is not shipped. Two columns, set by the style. preprint suppresses the venue and copyright block; accepted would stop with a PackageError if natbib is loaded with numbers (l.509-520). The style sets \pdfpagewidth only when it is defined, which XeTeX has. With the default or preprint mode the running heading is fixed text; in accepted mode a title wider than \textwidth stops with 'Running heading title exceeds size limitations' (l.228).
